headline_gap.sql:
with grouped as (
    select
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then case when is_closed then n_requests else 0 end else 0 end) as a_numerator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then n_requests else 0 end) as a_denominator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) and (outcome_group = 'fixed') then n_requests else 0 end) as b_numerator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then n_requests else 0 end) as b_denominator
    from mart_outcomes_monthly
    where (created_month between ? and ?) and (era = 'current')
)
select *, round((a_numerator / nullif(a_denominator, 0) - b_numerator / nullif(b_denominator, 0)) * 100, 4) as value_
from grouped

q4_closed_within_30d_monthly.coverage: Categories that exist in both systems, crew self-reports excluded.
q4_closed_within_30d_monthly.sql:

    select
        cast(date_trunc('month', created_month) as date) as period_start,
        "unified_category" as unified_category,
        "era" as era,
        sum(case when (NOT FALSE) then n_closed_within_30d else 0 end) as numerator,

q5_outcome_by_time_to_close.sql: select case when hours_to_close < 1.0 / 60 then '1: under 1 minute' when hours_to_close < 1 then '2: 1 minute to 1 hour' when hours_to_close < 24 then '3: 1 hour to 1 day' when hours_to_close < 7 * 24 then '4: 1 to 7 days' when hours_to_close < 30 * 24 then '5: 7 to 30 days' else '6: over 30 days' end as time_to_close, count(*) as closed, avg(case when outcome_group = 'fixed' then 1.0 else 0 end) as fixed_share, avg(case when outcome_group = 'not_fixed' then 1.0 else 0 end) as not_fixed_share, avg(case when closure_outcome = 'closed_unspecified' then 1.0 else 0 end) as unspecified_share from fct_current_requests where is_closed and hours_to_close >= 0 and not is_crew_self_report and coalesce(outcome_group, '') not in ('neutral', 'handed_off') and created_month between ? and ? group by 1 order by 1

e2_seconds_to_close_current.sql: select case when hours_to_close * 3600 < 10 then '1: under 10 seconds' when hours_to_close * 3600 < 60 then '2: 10 to 59 seconds' when hours_to_close * 60 < 2 then '3: 1 to 2 minutes' when hours_to_close * 60 < 5 then '4: 2 to 5 minutes' when hours_to_close * 60 < 10 then '5: 5 to 10 minutes' when hours_to_close < 1 then '6: 10 to 60 minutes' else '7: an hour or more' end as time_to_close, count(*) as closed, avg(case when outcome_group = 'fixed' then 1.0 else 0 end) as fixed_share, avg(case when outcome_group = 'neutral' then 1.0 else 0 end) as neutral_share, avg(case when closure_outcome = 'closed_unspecified' then 1.0 else 0 end) as unspecified_share from marts.fct_service_requests where era = 'current' and is_closed and hours_to_close >= 0 and not is_crew_self_report group by 1 order by 1

e2_legacy_precision.sql: select case when year(created_at) <= 2019 then '2015-2019' else '2020-2025' end as years, count(*) filter (where hours_to_close = 0) as closed_at_0_seconds, count(*) filter (where hours_to_close > 0 and hours_to_close * 60 < 1) as closed_1_to_59_seconds, count(*) as closed from marts.fct_service_requests where era = 'legacy' and is_closed and hours_to_close >= 0 and not is_crew_self_report group by 1 order by 1

e2_instant_close_thresholds.sql: select era, count(*) as closed, avg(case when hours_to_close * 60 <= 1 then 1.0 else 0 end) as within_1_min, avg(case when hours_to_close * 60 <= 2 then 1.0 else 0 end) as within_2_min, avg(case when hours_to_close * 60 <= 5 then 1.0 else 0 end) as within_5_min, avg(case when hours_to_close * 60 <= 10 then 1.0 else 0 end) as within_10_min from marts.fct_service_requests where is_crosswalked and cross_era_comparison <> 'volume_only' and not is_crew_self_report and is_closed and hours_to_close >= 0 group by era order by era
